stemMarkdown: Find the remainder when $202 \times 768$ is divided by $9$.
solutionMarkdown: Reduce each factor first: $202 \equiv 4$ and $768 \equiv 3 \pmod{9}$. So the product is $\equiv 4 \times 3 = 12 \equiv 3 \pmod{9}$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Reducing before multiplying keeps the numbers small — the remainder is unaffected.
